paragraphs: Punia. R' Shmuel bar Punia — Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, end of chapter 1.[^1]

notes.text: פסדר״כ ספ״א is expanded as Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, end of chapter 1. Earlier machine OCR had בפ״א instead of supplied ספ״א; it is not treated as a verified printed variant. No named edition is independently checked. The abbreviated personal title remains R'.
